findings.title: reduce=<fitted Reducer> is documented for plot() but always crashes: plot re-applies the fitted model to its own already-reduced 3-column output
findings.repro:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
_, model = hyp.reduce(rng.normal(0, 1, (50, 10)), reduce='PCA', ndims=3, return_model=True)
print(np.asarray(hyp.reduce(rng.normal(0,1,(30,10)), reduce=model)).shape)  # (30, 3) OK
hyp.plot(rng.normal(0, 1, (30, 10)), fmt='.', reduce=model, show=False)  # ValueError
findings.expected: plot(reduce=<fitted Reducer>) renders the new data in the fitted 3-D space (like hyp.reduce alone does).

findings.title: align=False raises ValueError('unknown model: False') though plot()/align()/analyze() docstrings all promise 'If False or None, no alignment is applied'
findings.expected: No alignment applied (identical to align=None), per the docstring of plot(), align(), and analyze().
findings.actual: ValueError: unknown model: False  (raised from hypertools/core/shared.py:143/154 via hypertools/tools/align.py, which only handles `align is None`)

findings.title: cluster=False raises ValueError('Invalid cluster model specified') though plot()'s docstring types cluster as 'str, dict, False, or None'
findings.expected: No clustering (identical to cluster=None), per the documented type 'str, dict, False, or None'.
findings.actual: ValueError: Invalid cluster model specified; should be string or dictionary!

findings.title: Misspelled pipeline kwargs (n_dims, nclusters, allign, normalise) run the whole pipeline then surface as a matplotlib artist AttributeError (or a plotly 'ignoring' warning + silently-default plot)
findings.expected: An error (or at least a warning) suggesting the correct parameter, e.g. "unexpected keyword 'n_dims' -- did you mean 'ndims'?", before the pipeline runs.
findings.actual: AttributeError: Line2D.set() got an unexpected keyword argument 'n_dims'  |  plotly: UserWarning: backend='plotly' cannot map the following extra kwarg(s) to a trace property and will ignore them: ['n_dims']. (figure renders with default ndims=3 pipeline)

findings.title: Invalid normalize= value raises a self-contradictory AssertionError that names the internal 'scale_type' and lists 'none' as accepted -- but normalize='none' raises the same assertion
findings.expected: ValueError naming the `normalize` kwarg and its actually-accepted values ('across', 'within', 'row', False, None); the string 'none' should either work or not be advertised.
findings.actual: AssertionError: scale_type must be across, within, row, none, or a fitted Normalizer.

findings.title: Integer-valued group labels passed as hue= are silently treated as CONTINUOUS values (no grouping, no legend possible); only non-numeric labels group categorically -- the docstring never states this dtype rule
findings.repro:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
rng = np.random.default_rng(5)
D = np.vstack([rng.normal(i * 6, 1, (30, 8)) for i in range(3)])
fig = hyp.plot(D, fmt='.', hue=np.repeat([0, 1, 2], 30), legend=True, show=False)
print(len(fig.axes[0].lines))  # 0 -> continuous path, legend warning
findings.expected: Either a small integer label set is grouped categorically, or the docstring states the numeric-dtype -> continuous rule and the legend warning suggests casting labels to str.
findings.actual: n_lines=0, n_coll=7 + UserWarning: legend is not supported for continuous or matrix-valued hue; ignoring legend. (str labels: n_lines=3, legend=['a','b','c'])

findings.title: Datasets with differing feature counts crash plot() with a raw numpy vstack error from the reduce stage, while hyp.align alone handles the same input
findings.expected: Either the pipeline pads/handles mixed feature counts (as hyp.align does) or a clear ValueError: 'datasets have differing numbers of features (10 vs 7); hypertools requires equal feature counts for reduce -- pad or align first.'
findings.actual: ValueError: all the input array dimensions except for the concatenation axis must match exactly, but along dimension 1, the array at index 0 has size 10 and the array at index 1 has size 7

findings.title: One plot() call emits stage warnings twice: legacy reduce-dict DeprecationWarning x2 and hyperalign row-trim UserWarning x2
findings.repro:
import sys, warnings; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
x = np.random.default_rng(5).normal(0, 1, (50, 8))
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    hyp.plot(x, fmt='.', reduce={'model': 'PCA', 'params': {}}, show=False)
print(sum(1 for i in w if i.category is DeprecationWarning))  # 2
findings.expected: Each distinct warning at most once per plot() call.
findings.actual: DeprecationWarnings in one plot() call: 2; trim warnings in one plot() call: 2
